messages:
devops-bot: [ALERT] P1: Region fallback loop detected for smart-routing (us-east <-> us-west <-> eu). Elevated 5xx and latency spikes. Affected frontend: /v1/generate. Auto-fallbacks toggling every ~30s. Alerting on-call.

sam: saw this spike on dashboards, queues building. grabbing on-call. @pagerduty paging lee.

pagerduty: Paging lee (on-call ops) — high priority incident. See incident runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/region-fallback

lee: on it. Observing health-check flaps for inference-proxy in eu -> us-west -> us-east. Smart-routing policy shows fallback enabled with cooldown=30s and max_retries=3. logs:
```
2026-03-15T03:00:12Z proxy healthcheck failed region=eu reason=503
2026-03-15T03:00:42Z proxy healthcheck ok region=eu
2026-03-15T03:01:12Z proxy healthcheck failed region=eu reason=503
```

lee: initial mitigation: disabling cross-region fallback to stop loop. running: `redwoodctl routing update --smart-fallback disabled --scope global` — will let us serve from last-known-good region rather than cycling.

maria: +1. Also suggests increasing health-check stable window to 90s for the proxy and lower sensitivity on TTL-based checks. Command: `redwoodctl infra set-health-config --component proxy --stable-window 90s --failure-threshold 3`

sam: customer impact: some high-throughput customers (acct: acme, beta-shop) seeing 5xx ~18% for last 15m; SLA alerts triggered. effort: put a temporary pin for those customers to us-east (local) while we stabilize.

lee: doing pinning: `redwoodctl route pin --customer acme --region us-east --duration 2h` — applying to top 5 impacted tenants.

devops-bot: Action log: smart-fallback disabled by lee at 03:06Z, routing pins applied to 5 tenants, scaled inference-pool us-east +3 GPUs.

maria: rolling restart of eu proxy nodes in progress to clear bad state: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/proxy -n inference-eu` — will monitor health.

lee: after disabling fallback and pinning, 5xx decreased to ~4% and tail latency normalizing. Still seeing some residual retries from queued requests. Monitoring.

sam: handoff to maria for verification and customer comms. sam -> maria: please draft brief for affected customers and update status page.

maria: will take over. Draft status: "We experienced a short-lived routing loop causing elevated errors; mitigations applied, service recovery in progress. Eng investigating root cause (health-check sensitivity + flaky proxy)." Posting now.

devops-bot: Incident severity remains P1. Owner: lee. Current status: Mitigated. Recovery in progress. Next step: postmortem + adjust default fallback config.

lee: marking incident mitigated at 03:40Z. Will add followups: revert pins after 2h, tune fallback cooldown to 120s, add jitter and exponential backoff to health-checks and fallback decisions.

maria: creating postmortem ticket: PM-3217, will include timeline, affected customers, config change proposal, and test plan for canarying fallback changes.

sam: thanks team. If anything regresses ping this thread. Closing handoff to maria.

maria: will update once postmortem is drafted and changes are scheduled. Thanks. :thumbsup:
